channel.title: Religion News Service - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Religion News Service (religionnews.com)

item.title: Faith in Action: Bishop Dwayne Royster’s Call to Justice
item.description: In recent days, faith communities have stepped up in powerful ways. Here's what that means for all of us. Also, suing the administration over the Religious Liberty Commission's makeup.

item.title: What is and isn’t new about US bishops’ criticism of Trump’s foreign policy
item.description: The Catholic Church’s teachings on ‘just war’ have guided leaders’ long history of opposing many military interventions.

item.title: UK’s royal astronomers join hunt for Ramadan’s crescent moon
item.description: The New Crescent Society, which is organizing the Greenwich event with the Royal Observatory, is hoping moon sighting will become fully established in Britain and be used by mosques.

item.title: When Trauma Becomes Identity: Rabbi Steven Burg on Changing the Script for Young Jews
item.description: Rabbi Steven Burg, CEO of Aish, asks young Jews who they are. The answer worries him.

item.title: This Ramadan, I’m choosing emptiness over exhaustion
item.description: Wasn’t this month meant to serve as a divine mercy for us all — a momentary breather, not an added burden?

item.title: Amid ICE raids, Minneapolis rabbi and pastor show solidarity in action
item.description: The partnership includes joint worship — and a $1 million fundraising drive for Minneapolis families affected by the siege.

item.title: Judge bars most ICE raids at a group of churches that sued the Trump administration
item.description: The impact of the new ruling may be larger than a similar court decision last year, as the plaintiffs appear to represent a much higher number of churches.

item.title: ‘The divine will come’: On Lord Shiva’s night, Hindus channel deity’s energy at the heart of creation
item.description: Mahashivratri, which means “the Great Night of Shiva” in Sanskrit, takes place as Lord Shiva's cosmic energies are said to be at their highest.

item.title: Can Zionism be rebranded?
item.description: We cannot simply cede its meaning to the haters.

item.title: ‘We’re praying with our feet’: a year of pro-democracy prayer vigils in New York
item.description: As New York braces for a large-scale deployment of ICE agents, the vigils imposed themselves as a hub for the city’s religious left and became an incubator for other mobilizations.
